model.flight_information.int_flight_type.compiled_code:
with ticket_information as (

    select * from "postgres"."intermediate"."int_ticket_information"

),

flight_type as (

    select
        flight_id,
        route_no,
        flight_status,
        scheduled_departure,
        scheduled_arrival,
        actual_departure,
        actual_arrival,
        
    case
        when actual_departure is null or actual_arrival is null then null
        when extract(epoch from (actual_arrival::timestamp - actual_departure::timestamp)) / 3600 <= 1 then 'short flight'
        when extract(epoch from (actual_arrival::timestamp - actual_departure::timestamp)) / 3600 <= 5 then 'average flight'
        else 'long flight'
    end
 as flight_type
    from ticket_information

)

select * from flight_type

model.flight_information.int_bookings_di.name: int_bookings_distribution
model.flight_information.int_bookings_di.raw_code:
with bookings as (

    select * from {{ ref('stg_bookings') }}

),

bookings_distribution as (

    select
        extract(hour from book_date) as booking_hour,
        count(*) as booking_count,
        sum(total_amount) as total_revenue,
        avg(total_amount) as avg_booking_amount
    from bookings
    group by extract(hour from book_date)
    order by booking_hour

)

select * from bookings_distribution
